rows: No APN/address; no fixed tract set
Create the access-controlled internal workspace; version the tract set. Nothing identifying is published.
No lease document; exact expiration within 2030-2035 unknown; no notice calendar
Abstract the lease, reconcile to a notice calendar, then lock option and notice dates.
City/county proxies only; no tract trend, zoning, AADT, school or competitor evidence
Fix tracts, pull multi-vintage ACS, ZIMAS, AADT, school and competitor data.
Regional figures verified; tract-level and unit-level inputs absent
Keep the multi-period evidence; add trade-area and unit-level series.
Regional hazard context only; no parcel zone status, engineering report or quotes
Run four parcel lookups plus engineering and insurance quotes; stress rent loss, repairs and exit liquidity together.
Verified federal/state rules; no owner basis, depreciation, loan, filing status or tax rate area
Populate private inputs in the browser-only calculator; do not store them.
No verified short-lease quote set, comps or negotiated renewal proposal
Collect arm's-length quotes/comp pairs and a written renewal proposal; price the discount from real quotes only.
No versioned back-tested cash-flow model; no winner selected
Back-test only with sufficient verified comparable history; compare after-tax sale with negotiated renewal; select privately.
